items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: You know Marcus around the corner.

ctx.x: But I don't know if the kids can get that today, if they go to NBC and do a night, and with all that amplification, they must. They just must inside, have a feeling of satisfaction on some nights that they get together. Although I'm not into that music. If they're having problems, I'd be happy to -- I've met guys in New York who do shows, good shows, that are also swingers. You know Marcus around the corner.
Well, what I'm trying to say and what I'm trying to find out -- for a matter of record, that these young people love you, and they would like to come to you.
